rules.canonical_bytes: hash before/after every source, declaration, package and identity transition
rules.same_candidate: all G1/G2/G3 and downstream refs must bind exact candidate and authority
rules.unknown: unknown external facts are typed_absent, never null-as-present
rules.fault: unexpected tool/runtime fault is program_exception and cannot promote

interfaces.absence: missing authority/source/provider => typed_absent; no synthesized ref/hash

input: exactly one G1 and one G2 record
interfaces.absence: duplicate/missing/unknown layer or target mismatch => fail_closed; missing authority => typed_absent

input: fresh external authority record or typed absence
interfaces.absence: unchanged external set => terminal_deferred/no_publish; legacy authority cannot be synthesized
any missing required child remains typed_absent; no actual candidate identity
stale, foreign, or changed upstream receipt => fail_closed and rebuild required
contract-only typed absence; no formal B00/B04 credit
missing any formal artifact leaves gate open/locked

forbidden_promotions: any component result to R01-R10 credit
